QuestInfo.name: Zombie Lupin's Threat
QuestInfo.0: #p1040004# was clearly relieved when you returned his staff, but something more is troubling him. Ask him what is it.
QuestInfo.1: He told you that #o3210800#s have changed in a very strange way. He said they now remind him of zombies... #b#p1040004##k wants you to collect dolls from #r#o4230101#s#k so that he can study the change in the #r#o4230101#s#k. Eliminate #b50#k #r#o4230101#s#k and bring #b#t4000031#s#k to Luvar. #r#o4230101#s#k appear in #b#m101040200##k.
QuestInfo.2: When you brought the #t4000031#s to #p1040004#, his face grew even darker. What could this mean?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 4,000 Can proceed to the Francois?! quest

0.0: Now that that's settled, are you interested in helping me with something a bit more...sinister? If you can stomach a little evil, that is.

yes.0: Good choice! All right, I'll make this simple. #o3210800#s are turning into zombies. Boom, there you go. Oh, and I have no idea what's turning the #o3210800#s into zombies.
yes.1: Well, okay, I have ONE idea. The #r#o4230101##k all carry dolls. That's pretty weird, I think we can agree. So, I need you to go to the #b#m101040200##k and collect about #b50 #t4000031#s#k from those #r#o4230101##k.

no.0: Fair enough. Mind-breaking, world-shattering evil is not something every adventurer can deal with. I still respect you...a little.

1.0: Whoa, what is that dark, evil, doomy feeling...? Oh, hey, you brought the #t4000031#s! Great.

yes.0: Now, let me examine these. Whoo...these are really evil. I'm talking weapons-grade evil, here.

item.0: Still getting the #b50 #t4000031#s#k together? Fine, but be careful. #r#o4230101#s#k are much stronger than regular #o3210800#s. I wouldn't think becoming a zombie would make something stronger, but there you go. Most of the #r#o4230101#s#k are in the #b#m101040200##k.
